metadata.title: Runaway OB stars within 1 kpc of the Sun

notes: No eligible stars. The paper classifies “runaway stars” as stars ejected from their birth environments (T:p1-b6; T:p1-b9) and applies a 2D peculiar-velocity threshold for runaway selection (T:p6-b8). It does not state that any star is unbound from the Milky Way or apply a Galactic escape/unbound criterion; runaway/ejection labels alone do not establish the required candidacy.
